Malayalam Festivals 2032 / മലയാളം കലണ്ടര്‍ 2032

मलयालम कैलेंडर, जिसे कोल्लवर्षम कहते हैं, केरल का पारंपरिक सौर कैलेंडर है। इसके महीने सूर्य के राशि बदलने (संक्रमण) से शुरू होते हैं, और पहला महीना चिंगम है। नीचे 2032 के ओणम, विशु और अन्य त्योहारों की तारीखें हैं।

The Malayalam calendar (Kollavarsham, കൊല്ലവർഷം) is the traditional solar calendar of Kerala. Each month begins when the Sun enters a new zodiac sign (the Sankramam), and the year begins with Chingam, the month of Onam. The dates below are the festivals of 2032, worked out for Delhi (IST).

Malayalam New Year and the Kollam year

The Malayalam New Year falls on 17 August 2032, the first day of Chingam, and starts Kollavarsham 1208. Kollavarsham counts from 825 CE, so the Kollam year is the Gregorian year minus 824 once Chingam begins. Karkidakam, the last month, is traditionally the month of the Ramayana reading.

Popular Malayalam festivals

  • Onam: Thiruvonam, when the Shravana nakshatra falls in Chingam.
  • Vishu: the first day of Metam, with the Vishukkani ritual and Vishukkaineettam.
  • Thiruvathira: the Ardra nakshatra in Dhanu, celebrated mainly by women.
  • Thrissur Pooram: the Pooram nakshatra of Metam.
  • Makaravilakku: Makara Sankramam at Sabarimala. Mandalakala is the 41-day season that begins on Vrischikam 1.
  • Sankramam: the first day of each solar month.

Eclipses are shown for 2026 only. For other regional dates, see the Tamil Festivals, Telugu Festivals and Hindu Calendar.

Malayalam Festivals FAQs

When is Onam in 2032?

Onam (Thiruvonam) falls on 20 August 2032, the day the Shravana nakshatra rules in the month of Chingam.

When is Vishu in 2032?

Vishu is on 14 April 2032, the first day of Metam. It moves between 14 and 15 April depending on when the Sun enters Mesha.

When is the Malayalam New Year in 2032?

The Malayalam New Year (Chingam 1) is on 17 August 2032.

Is the Malayalam calendar solar or lunar?

It is a solar calendar. Months start at the Sun's transit into a new sign (Sankramam), while festivals such as Onam and Vishu also use the nakshatra.

Dates are for Delhi (IST) and may differ by a day in other cities or traditions. Confirm important festivals with your family pandit.
